title: Phoenix (X4: Foundations)
intro: The Phoenix is a large Teladi destroyer flown from the captain's chair. The pilot fires its forward main guns; its eleven turrets fire on their own.

panels.name: Phoenix: seat and weapons
panels.text: Facts about the Phoenix that set it apart from other X4 ships: where the pilot sits and which guns, turrets and docking it has.
panels.context: All other controls of the Phoenix are the shared X4 controls of this guide.

controls.name: Captain's chair (bridge)
controls.text: The Phoenix is a big ship, so the pilot flies it from the captain's chair on the bridge instead of a small cockpit. The stick controls are the same as in a fighter.
controls.context: A big ship like the Phoenix turns and speeds up slowly; the pilot plans moves earlier than in a fighter.

controls.name: Main guns
controls.text: The Phoenix has two big forward main guns. They fire with the trigger and aim where the ship's nose points.
controls.context: Turning a ship as big as the Phoenix onto a target takes time, so the main guns suit big, slow targets.

controls.name: Turrets
controls.text: The Phoenix carries eleven turrets, gun mounts that turn and fire on their own without the pilot.
controls.context: How the turrets behave (attack all enemies, defend, hold fire) is set in the menus, not on the sticks.
